    """add_days('2026-01-31', 3) == '2026-02-03'"""
    year, month, day = map(int, date_str.split('-'))
    days_in_month = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0):
        days_in_month[1] = 29
    total_days = day + n
    # Handle negative days
    if total_days < 0:
        total_days += days_in_month[month - 1] * 2
    # Handle positive days
    elif total_days > days_in_month[month - 1]:
        total_days -= days_in_month[month - 1]
        month += 1
        if month > 12:
            month = 1
            year += 1
    # Adjust month and year if needed
    if month > 12:
        month = 1
        year += 1
    # Ensure month is correct
    if month == 0:
        month = 12
        year -= 1
    # Now, calculate the new date
    new_day = total_days
    new_month = month
    new_year = year
    # If the new_day is 0, adjust to the last day of the previous month
    if new_day == 0:
        new_day = days_in_month[new_month - 2] if new_month > 1 else days_in_month[11]
        new_month -= 1
    # If the new_month is 0, adjust to December of the previous year
    if new_month == 0:
        new_month = 12
        new_year -= 1
    # Format the date
    return f"{new_year}-{new_month:02d}-{new_day:02d}""}
